content: Features. We argue that different kinds of features like the sentiment of the text, morality, and other text-based features are critical to detect the nonfactual Twitter accounts by utilizing their occurrence during reporting the news in an account's timeline. We employ a rich set of features borrowed from previous works in fake news, bias, and rumors detection BIBREF0, BIBREF1, BIBREF8, BIBREF9.
